name: Valqua, Ltd.
summary: Valqua, Ltd. designs, manufactures, processes, and sells fiber, fluorocarbon resin, rubber, and other materials in Japan, rest of Asia, the United States, and internationally. It operates through the Seal Products Business and Functional Resin Products Business segments. The company offers seal products, including soft gaskets, metallic/semi-metallic gaskets, molded and gland packing, metallic bellows, and supplement products for seal, as well as other seals comprising oil sheets, other gaskets, and alliance products.
